fixed.summary: On og-ui's new core, an image element shows its texture: a .svelte `` and a TSX `` paint the Texture handle they name (`og.load.texture`, a video player's texture) as their box image, with its classes' slice, tint and wipe, and follow a texture that loads or is replaced. A new-core frame painted right after another is no longer dropped: every other repaint was, so a change could stay unseen until the next one.
